name: promptforge-chat
description: Chat with your indexed codebase via the PromptForge RAG pipeline

commands.name: query
commands.description: Ask a question and get an answer (default mode)

commands.name: forge
commands.description: Forge a paste-ready prompt instead of answering

promptforge.backendDir.description: Path to PromptForge/backend for auto-start. Empty = look for backend/app/main.py in the workspace.

promptforge.pythonPath.description: Python executable for auto-start. Empty = <backendDir>/.venv/Scripts/python.exe (or bin/python).

promptforge.model.description: Ollama generation model override. Empty = backend default. Set via /model in chat.

promptforge.ollamaUrl.description: Ollama URL (used by /model to list installed models)
